experiment.name: Calibrated clinic v1 · 20 scenarios × 3 repeats
experiment.hypothesis: Pre-registered: making clinic-policy available as a Hermes skill should improve policy pass rate versus the same Haiku baseline, without regressions on controls. Context cases accept CRM notes or Hermes memory. Frozen clinic eval v1; 20 tasks; three repetitions per configuration; Claude-played customer; calibrated Sonnet judge and Jev 1.14.0. Interpret uncertainty and critical regressions before selecting a winner.
